curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with who must buckle up, then primary versus secondary enforcement, who is answerable for which passengers, the stricter GDL duty, the exemptions and wheelchair securement.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards that keep primary and secondary enforcement apart and the ordinary driver duty apart from the GDL duty.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps primary and secondary enforcement and ordinary versus GDL passenger duties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the survival figures, the three-story fall comparison, how belts slow the body with the vehicle, correct lap and shoulder belt position, one belt per person, and why air bags never replace belts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per fact; a contrast card that separates the sixty percent figure from the three to four times figure.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on belt survival figures, belt position and belt misuse.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through child restraint labels, the never-forward infant seat, the three age and size thresholds, the rear-seat rule for children under eight, the autocycle limit and the fine.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per threshold or rule; contrast cards that keep the under-two, under-four and under-eight thresholds apart.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps child-seat ages, weights and heights.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover what air bags add to belts, how fast they inflate, why they endanger children in front, the rear-facing seat ban, children twelve and younger in back, how to spot an air bag and when a cutoff switch fits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per fact; contrast cards for the driver-side, passenger-side and dual switches and for the front-seat bans.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on air bag risks, markings and cutoff switch uses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Check backup, brake and headlights, the warning signs of brake trouble, drying brakes after water, conventional versus anti-lock braking, the stopping test and proper horn use.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per check; contrast cards for pumping conventional brakes versus steady pressure on anti-lock brakes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps conventional and anti-lock brake handling and the light checks.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover steering checks, failed turn signals, tire pressure and tread, window tinting limits, clearing snow and ice and the fines for not clearing it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per check; contrast cards for tire pressure versus tread depth and for the snow and ice fine with or without falling snow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on tires, tinting and the snow and ice rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what carbon monoxide is, the vehicle faults and situations that let it build up, why symptoms may come too late and what to do when poisoning is suspected.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per fact; a contrast card that corrects the open garage door belief.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on carbon monoxide sources, symptoms and response.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the check around the vehicle, the pre-drive setup, vision and eye exams, glare and aging eyes, mirror setup and checks, looking back before moving, and the idling limit with its fines.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per step; contrast cards for the idling limit versus its exemptions and the mirror setup versus the on-road check.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on pre-drive steps, mirrors, vision and idling.
